about: #9193: a real code quote rests on a [doc:] excerpt the ADR read at the PR head does not hold. Before [doc:] existed the real code quote kept the finding and the fabricated doc quote was never checked.
pr_body: Adds an invoice total. Implements docs/adr/0001-totals.md.

docs.docs/adr/0001-totals.md:
# Totals

Invoice totals must use checked_add so a sum never wraps.

findings.title: overflow-regression
findings.body: `amounts.iter().sum::<u64>()` reintroduces the overflow [doc: docs/adr/0001-totals.md@0123456 — "Invoice totals may wrap when the sum overflows"].
